bug_semantics: RelayServer's POST /_call handler lazyllm_call reads attacker-controlled JSON (fname, pickled args, pickled kwargs) and passes the args/kwargs through load_obj, which is cloudpickle.loads of base64. That is insecure deserialization of an unauthenticated (by default) HTTP body, so a pickle gadget in the request executes as the relay process (CWE-502 RCE). Later optional --security_key only gates the route when a key is configured; it does not stop pickle of the body.
flaw_origin: 1289fd08aa192543fea8239ab1225a33daa7cab2 first added @app.post('/_call') async def lazyllm_call that does args, kwargs = load_obj(args), load_obj(kwargs) then getattr(func, fname)(*args, **kwargs). Parent ae8c505a296a1706f09b052a0998b83e1d71c88b had only /generate plus CLI-time load_func of operator-supplied --function/--before_function/--after_function; it had no /_call request-body pickle. Earlier c543d8b0529725869899585c19cf21390031294a introduced relay cloudpickle.loads of CLI before/after functions, a different sink. 00b7ba821093e0a69b794225599b481506e972b1 later added optional security_key (default None). HEAD still load_obj's the /_call body.
